detail: Stored byte-exact and hashed. Marked in amber: the source every derived table is rebuilt from; a rebuild reads it and never changes it.

label: in seq order
detail: A rebuild starts every session from its first row.

label: stamps version
detail: Every parse run is recorded with the parser version.

label: older: rebuild
detail: No successful run yet, or one from an older parser version, makes the next parse a full rebuild.

label: per match
detail: Replaced match by match; a rebuild empties all 18 tables first and rolls back on any error.

label: read
detail: A test fails if any view's SQL names the raw table.

label: card facts
detail: Card names, colours and costs, loaded by command from the game's card database, opened read-only.
Not drawn: the views also read run history and the session table.
